svg.text: twelve legal transitions — exactly one of them automatic
ONE transition is automatic: NOT STARTED → IN PROGRESS, when a sync reports playtime > 0 on a game whose status_manual is NULL. Every other arrow on this sheet is the player.
A SYNC NEVER WRITES status_manual. Mark a game ZERADO, then play three more hours: playtime updates, last_played_at updates, the state does not. That invariant is what makes the product trustworthy.
ZERADO is never inferred. 100% achievements may SUGGEST it in Phase 2 — a dismissible line the player accepts. A machine cannot hand someone the moment the product exists to create.
All twelve ordered pairs are legal. For providers with no playtime capability — physical copies, and any store whose API does not report it — all four states are manual, always.
The four game states and their transitions. Every arrow but one is the player. effective_status = status_manual ?? derive(playtime, capabilities).
